paper_title: Intersection Theorems: A Potential Approach to Proof Complexity Lower Bounds
statement: We conjecture that it might be easier to prove lower bounds for PHP in RevRes(⊕) for the following reason: RevRes is strictly weaker than Res, so it is highly likely that RevRes(⊕) is strictly weaker than Res(⊕).
